subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a typical component of a welding cable's construction?
solution:
The correct answer is __Steel core**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Welding cables__ are designed for high flexibility and durability.
 
• They typically consist of fine copper wires to ensure good conductivity.
 
• The outer layer is made of rubber insulation to provide electrical safety and protection.
 
• Some cables may include woven fabric reinforcing layers for added strength.
 
• __Steel core__ is not a typical component of welding cables.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Copper wires:**

 
 
• Copper is preferred for welding cables due to its excellent conductivity.
 
• Fine strands ensure flexibility and ease of use in varying environments.
 
 
 
• **Rubber insulation:**
 
 
• Rubber insulation protects the cable from external damages.
 
• It ensures safety by preventing electrical leakage.
 
 
 
• **Woven fabric reinforcing layers:**
 
 
• Added to enhance the strength and durability of the welding cable.
 
• Prevents wear and tear from frequent handling and use.
